sanskrit: uttvā mandantu somāḥ kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ . ava brahmadviṣo jahi
english: May the somas gladden you, O wielder of the stone; bestow your bounty. Strike down the enemies of sacred speech.

sanskrit: girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutaṃ madhordhārābhirajyase . indra tvādātamidyaśaḥ
english: O lover of hymns, protect our pressed soma; you are anointed with streams of sweetness. Indra, glory comes only from your gift.

sanskrit: sadā va indraścarkṛṣadā upo nu sa saparyan . na devo vṛtaḥ śūra indraḥ
english: Indra has always been drawing you near and attending upon you duly. No god is chosen over valiant Indra.

sanskrit: ā tvā viśantvindavaḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ . na tvāmindrāti ricyate
english: May the soma drops enter you as rivers flow into the ocean. No one surpasses you, O Indra.

sanskrit: indramidgāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ . indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata
english: The singers praise Indra loudly, the chanters praise Indra with their hymns. The melodies have celebrated Indra.

sanskrit: indra iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇamṛbhuṃ rayim . vājī dadātu vājinam
english: May Indra give us food, the Ṛbhu-lord grants Ṛbhu-wealth. May the prize-winner give us the prize.

sanskrit: indro aṅga mahadbhayamabhī ṣadapa cucyavat . sa hi sthiro vicarṣaṇiḥ
english: Indra alone has driven away great terror, moving against it. For he is steadfast and far-seeing.

sanskrit: imā u tvā sutesute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ . gāvo vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ
english: These songs attend you at each pressing, O lover of hymns, as milch-cows seek their calf.

sanskrit: indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayaṃ sakhyāya svastaye . huvema vājasātaye
english: Let us now call upon Indra and Pūṣan for friendship, for well-being, for the winning of strength.

sanskrit: na ki indra tvaduttaraṃ na jyāyo asti vṛtrahan . na kyevaṃ yathā tvam
english: None is higher than you, O Indra, none is greater, O slayer of Vṛtra. None is like you.

sanskrit: samānamu pra śaṃsiṣam
english: I shall praise him who is the same to all alike.

sanskrit: asṛgramindra te giraḥ prati tvāmudahāsata . sajoṣā vṛṣabhaṃ patim
english: These praises were released toward you, O Indra; they have joyfully risen up to greet you, the bull, the lord, with one accord.

sanskrit: sunītho ghā sa martyo yaṃ maruto yamaryamā . mitrāspāntyadruhaḥ
english: That mortal is truly well-guided whom the Maruts protect, whom Aryaman, Mitra, and Āspā guard from the treacherous.

sanskrit: yadvīḍāvindra yatsthire yatparśāne parābhṛtam . vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
english: Whatever desirable wealth lies in the firm stronghold, whatever is carried off in the rocky place — bring that, O Indra.

sanskrit: śrutaṃ vo vṛtrahantamaṃ pra śardhaṃ carṣaṇīnām . āśiṣe rādhase mahe
english: We have heard of the greatest slayer of Vṛtra; proclaim the host of peoples for blessing and for great bounty.

sanskrit: araṃ ta indra śravase gamema śūra tvāvataḥ . araṃ śakra paremaṇi
english: May we be equal to winning your glory, O Indra, O hero who wields such power. May we be equal, O Śakra, in your leading forth.

sanskrit: dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam . indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ
english: O Indra, delight in us at dawn — in our roasted grain, our groats, our cakes, and our recitations.

sanskrit: apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ . viśvā yadajaya spṛdhaḥ
english: With the foam of the waters, O Indra, you rolled off the head of Namuci, when you conquered all rivals.

sanskrit: ime ta indra somāḥ sutāso ye ca sotvāḥ . teṣāṃ matsva prabhūvaso
english: These, O Indra, are your pressed somas, and those yet to be pressed. Be gladdened by them, O lord of abundant wealth.

sanskrit: tubhyaṃ sutāsaḥ somāḥ stīrṇaṃ barhirvibhāvaso . stotṛbhya indra mṛḍaya
english: The pressed somas are for you; the sacred grass is spread, O lord of brilliant light. Show grace to your praisers, O Indra.

sanskrit: maṃhiṣṭhaṃ siñca indubhiḥ
english: Pour forth the most generous one with the soma drops.

sanskrit: ataścidindra na upā yāhi śatavājayā . iṣā sahasravājayā
english: Come near to us from here, O Indra, with hundredfold strength, with food and thousandfold strength.

sanskrit: ā bundaṃ vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchadvi mātaram . ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire
english: The slayer of Vṛtra, newly born, grasped the mace and asked his mother: who are the mighty here, who are heard among them?

sanskrit: bṛbadukthaṃ havāmahe sṛprakarasnamūtaye . sādhaḥ kṛṇvantamavase
english: We call on the utterer of great hymns, of flowing and streaming songs, for aid — the one who fulfills all goals, for protection.

sanskrit: ṛjunītī no varuṇo mitro nayati vidvān . aryamā devaiḥ sajoṣāḥ
english: Varuṇa leads us by straight guidance; Mitra leads us, the wise one; Aryaman, delighting together with the gods.

sanskrit: dūrādiheva yatsato 'ruṇapsuraśiśvitat . vi bhānuṃ viśvathātanat
english: The red, tawny light, as if coming from far away while standing here, has flashed forth; it has spread its radiance everywhere.

sanskrit: ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam . madhvā rajāṃsi sukratū
english: O Mitra and Varuṇa, sprinkle our pasture with ghee; you of good resolve, sprinkle the realms with sweetness.

sanskrit: udu tye sūnavo giraḥ kāṣṭhā yajñeṣvatnata . vāśrā abhijñu yātave
english: Those sons — the hymns — have stretched toward the highest regions in the sacrifices, resonating and bending their knees to journey forth.

sanskrit: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam . samūḍhamasya pāṃsule
english: Viṣṇu strode this out; he set down his step threefold. His footstep, shrouded in dust, is gathered together.

sanskrit: asya rātau sutaṃ piba
english: At his gifting, drink the pressed soma.

sanskrit: kadu pracetase mahe vaco devāya śasyate . tadidhyasya vardhanam
english: What speech is recited to the great, wise-minded god? That is truly the growth of his fire.

sanskrit: ukthaṃ ca na śasyamānaṃ nāgo rayirā ciketa . na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam
english: Neither the uktha hymn when recited, nor wealth, nor the snake perceive what is here. Nor is the Gāyatra metre when sung.

sanskrit: indra ukthebhirmandiṣṭho vājānāṃ ca vājapatiḥ . harivāntsutānāṃ sakhā
english: Indra is most gladdened by the uktha hymns, lord of prizes and of strengths, possessor of the bay horses, friend of those who press the soma.

sanskrit: ā yāhyupa naḥ sutaṃ vājebhirmā hṛṇīyathāḥ . mahāṃ iva yuvajāniḥ
english: Come near to our pressed soma with your prizes; do not be wrathful, like a great man with a young wife.

sanskrit: kadā vaso stotraṃ haryata ā ava śmaśā rudhadvāḥ . dīrghaṃ sutam vātāpyāya
english: When, O Vasu, will you be pleased with the praise? Come, halt your chariot — for a long draught of the pressed soma, that you may be satiated as by the wind.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇādindra rādhasaḥ pibā somamṛtūṃ ranu . tavedaṃ sakhyamastṛtam
english: O Indra, drink the soma from the brahmin's bounty, according to the seasons. This friendship with you is inviolable.

sanskrit: vayaṃ ghā te api smasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ . tvaṃ no jinva somapāḥ
english: We indeed are your praisers, O Indra, O lover of hymns. You, drinker of soma, quicken us.

sanskrit: endra pṛkṣu kāsu cinnṛmṇaṃ tanūṣu dhehi naḥ . satrājidugra pauṃsyam
english: O Indra, in whatever battles, place manly strength in our bodies. O all-conquering, mighty one — virility.

sanskrit: evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta sthiraḥ . evā te rādhyaṃ manaḥ
english: For you are truly a lover of heroes, and a hero, and steadfast. Your mind is truly one that achieves gifts.

sanskrit: īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣaḥ
english: Indra, lord of this moving world, beholding the sun, lord of what stands firm.

sanskrit: tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātau vājasya kārvaḥ . tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ
english: You alone we call, O brilliant one, at the winning of the prize. You, O Indra, lord of the good — the warriors call you in battles with Vṛtra; you at the racecourses for horses.

sanskrit: abhi pra vaḥ surādhasamindramarca yathā vide . yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati
english: Sing forth to Indra of great bounty, as is fitting. He, the generous one full of wealth, teaches his praisers as if with a thousand gifts.

sanskrit: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ . abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe
english: We proclaim that wonder-worker, conqueror in battle, gladdened with the wealth of soma — as milch-cows call their calf at evening time, so we call Indra with our songs.

sanskrit: tarobhirvo vidadvasumindraṃ sabādha ūtaye . bṛhadgāyantaḥ sutasome adhvare huve bharaṃ na kāriṇam
english: With penetrating songs I call Indra, finder of wealth, pressing together for your aid. Singing loudly at the sacrifice where soma is pressed, I call him like a bearer bearing a load.

sanskrit: taraṇiritsiṣāsati vājaṃ purandhyā yujā . ā va indraṃ puruhūtaṃ name girā nemiṃ taṣṭeva sudruvam
english: The swift one truly desires to win the prize, yoked with wisdom. I bend Indra, much-invoked, toward you with my song, as a craftsman bends a well-made wheel-rim.

sanskrit: pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ . āpirno bodhi sadhamādye vṛdhe3 'smāṃ avantu te dhiyaḥ
english: Drink of the pressed, flavorful soma; be gladdened, O Indra, as with one who possesses cattle. Be our ally in the shared enjoyment and growth; may your thoughts protect us.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hyehi cerave vidā bhagaṃ vasuttaye . udvāvṛṣasva maghavangaviṣṭaya udindrāśvamiṣṭaye
english: Come to the needy one; find him a share, a dwelling of wealth. Pour out your gifts, O generous one, for the winning of cattle, for the winning of horses, O Indra.

sanskrit: na hi vaścaramaṃ ca na vasiṣṭhaḥ parimaṃste . asmākamadya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibantu kāminaḥ
english: Neither does desire regard the last, nor Vasiṣṭha reflect too carefully. Today may all the Maruts, the willing ones, drink together at our soma-pressing.

sanskrit: mā cidanyadvi śaṃsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata . indramitstotā vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute muhurukthā ca śaṃsata
english: Speak of nothing else, O friends; suffer no harm. Praise only Indra the bull together at the soma-pressing; again and again recite the uktha hymns.

sanskrit: na kiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśadyaścakāra sadāvṛdham . indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrtamṛbhvasamadhṛṣṭaṃ dhṛṣṇumojasā
english: No one can attain him by action, the one who made the ever-growing — Indra, celebrated everywhere by sacrifices, wise and invincible, bold in his strength.
